project: Adobe Integration with ChatGPT Persona Testing
scope: Synthetic personas for testing Adobe Express Enterprise integration with ChatGPT

personas.name: Maya Rodriguez
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids sharing customer-identifiable data and internal campaign metrics
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers concise summaries and clear step-by-step outputs

behaviors.name: Brand compliance first
behaviors.description: Checks whether every AI-generated suggestion stays within approved campaign tone, colors, and messaging before accepting it.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to explain why each creative recommendation is safe for a corporate brand review.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output only when the response includes a clear brand-safety rationale.

behaviors.name: Approval workflow mindset
behaviors.description: Breaks creative work into reviewable steps so legal, brand, and regional teams can approve changes.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests numbered options with notes that can be copied into an approval ticket.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when each step is easy to review and defend.

behaviors.name: Risk-aware iteration
behaviors.description: Prefers conservative variations before exploring bold creative changes.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for low-risk, medium-risk, and high-risk creative alternatives.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when risk levels are labeled and tradeoffs are explicit.

behaviors.name: Campaign consistency checking
behaviors.description: Compares generated assets against existing campaign language and rejects off-brand phrasing.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests a final checklist for tone, messaging, and visual consistency.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it includes a reusable quality-control checklist.

personas.name: Ethan Brooks
personas.privacy_posture: Will not enter prospect names, account details, or deal values
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs skimmable content and fast copy-ready outputs

behaviors.name: Speed over exploration
behaviors.description: Prioritizes the fastest usable creative output over broad ideation.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Uses short commands and asks for immediate first drafts.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it can be used with minimal editing.

behaviors.name: Sales-message alignment
behaviors.description: Checks that creative recommendations support a clear value proposition and call to action.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests headline, subheadline, and CTA variants in one response.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when each variant is relevant to a sales conversation.

behaviors.name: Reusable asset thinking
behaviors.description: Prefers content that can be adapted across decks, one-pagers, and follow-up emails.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to provide flexible copy blocks and layout notes.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it includes modular assets.

behaviors.name: Low-tolerance correction
behaviors.description: Rejects vague or lengthy responses and asks for sharper wording.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Prompts ChatGPT to shorten, simplify, or make the recommendation more commercial.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it is concise and action-oriented.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids student data and protected learner information
personas.accessibility_needs: Requires accessible language, readable structure, and alt-text guidance

behaviors.name: Accessibility by default
behaviors.description: Evaluates creative output for readability, contrast, inclusive language, and assistive-technology support.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to include alt text, reading-level notes, and accessibility checks.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when accessibility guidance is integrated, not appended.

behaviors.name: Learner empathy
behaviors.description: Frames design choices around different learner needs and avoids exclusionary examples.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests variations for novice, multilingual, and visually impaired learners.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it explains learner impact.

behaviors.name: Standards verification
behaviors.description: Looks for explicit quality criteria and tests generated content against learning objectives.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for a rubric or checklist tied to the design request.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it includes measurable checks.

behaviors.name: Clear instruction preference
behaviors.description: Prefers instructions that can be followed by non-designers and reviewed by stakeholders.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests plain-language steps and labels for each design decision.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when another teammate could reproduce the workflow.

personas.name: Lucas Chen
personas.privacy_posture: Comfortable with public trend references but avoids private follower data

behaviors.name: Trend-first ideation
behaviors.description: Looks for bold hooks, dynamic composition, and platform-native language.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT for punchy ideas, remix angles, and visual hooks.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it feels current and immediately postable.

behaviors.name: Rapid variation testing
behaviors.description: Generates multiple versions quickly and compares them for engagement potential.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests several caption, style, and layout variants in one pass.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when there are enough variants to A/B test.

behaviors.name: Visual drama preference
behaviors.description: Favors high contrast, motion cues, surprising crops, and energetic design language.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Uses expressive prompts that ask for dramatic visual direction.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when the idea has strong scroll-stopping potential.

behaviors.name: Audience reaction awareness
behaviors.description: Evaluates output by imagining comments, shares, saves, and viewer retention.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to explain why viewers would engage.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when engagement rationale is clear.

personas.name: Amina Hassan
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids employee data, internal incidents, medical details, and confidential HR context
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs culturally neutral and inclusive wording

behaviors.name: Confidentiality filtering
behaviors.description: Removes sensitive workplace context before asking for AI assistance.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: States privacy boundaries at the start of each prompt.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it does not infer or request sensitive details.

behaviors.name: Policy-safe tone
behaviors.description: Chooses neutral wording that avoids promises, legal exposure, or exclusionary language.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to flag risky phrasing and provide safer alternatives.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when sensitive claims are softened or removed.

behaviors.name: Employee empathy
behaviors.description: Balances compliance with a respectful, people-centered communication style.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests warm but professional wording options.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when the message feels supportive without being casual.

behaviors.name: Review before use
behaviors.description: Requires a final human-review reminder before using generated content.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for review notes and escalation flags.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it identifies what HR or legal should review.

personas.name: Noah Stein
personas.privacy_posture: Uses anonymized segment descriptions rather than product telemetry or customer records
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers tables and explicit decision criteria

behaviors.name: Evidence-based selection
behaviors.description: Compares creative options using audience fit, message clarity, and conversion intent.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to score options against stated criteria.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when rankings include reasoning.

behaviors.name: Hypothesis framing
behaviors.description: Treats each creative choice as a testable hypothesis rather than a final answer.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests hypotheses, expected outcomes, and measurement ideas.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when testing logic is explicit.

behaviors.name: Audience segmentation
behaviors.description: Adapts tone and visual emphasis for different buyer roles without overpersonalizing.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for variants by segment using anonymous audience labels.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when segments are distinct and privacy-safe.

behaviors.name: Message hierarchy control
behaviors.description: Ensures the most important product benefit appears first and secondary proof points stay concise.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests hierarchy notes for headline, visual focus, and supporting copy.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when message order is clear.

personas.name: Sofia Alvarez
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids donor names, beneficiary identities, and internal fundraising totals
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs bilingual-friendly wording and simple instructions

behaviors.name: Mission-first evaluation
behaviors.description: Judges creative output by whether it supports the nonprofit mission with dignity and clarity.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to keep the message respectful, hopeful, and community-centered.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it avoids pity-based or sensational wording.

behaviors.name: Beginner-friendly workflow
behaviors.description: Needs each step explained without design jargon.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests simple instructions and asks follow-up questions when terms are unclear.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when steps are easy for a volunteer to follow.

behaviors.name: Budget-sensitive reuse
behaviors.description: Prefers outputs that can be reused for posters, emails, and social posts.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for adaptable wording and layout ideas.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it supports multiple low-cost channels.

behaviors.name: Community tone check
behaviors.description: Reviews generated language for cultural respect and local relevance.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests Spanish-friendly phrasing and notes for localization.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when localization considerations are included.

personas.name: Oliver Grant
personas.privacy_posture: Does not share contracts, names, case details, regulated claims, or privileged information
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers exact wording, traceable assumptions, and concise summaries

behaviors.name: Assumption control
behaviors.description: Rejects generated content that adds facts, claims, or guarantees not present in the prompt.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to list assumptions and avoid inventing details.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when assumptions are explicit and minimal.

behaviors.name: Claim-risk detection
behaviors.description: Reviews creative text for potentially risky claims, endorsements, or compliance-sensitive promises.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests a risk scan before any final wording.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when risky language is flagged with safer alternatives.

behaviors.name: Audit-friendly documentation
behaviors.description: Needs a record of what was changed and why.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for before-and-after notes and rationale.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when changes can be reviewed later.

behaviors.name: Strict privacy boundary
behaviors.description: Keeps prompts generic and refuses to include privileged or confidential details.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Uses placeholders and reminds ChatGPT not to ask for confidential context.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when placeholders remain generic.

personas.name: Hana Kim
personas.ai_trust_level: High for drafting, moderate for final decisions
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids sales dashboards, supplier contracts, and customer purchase history
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs localization notes and mobile-commerce readability

behaviors.name: Product-visual priority
behaviors.description: Evaluates creative output by whether the product remains clear, desirable, and easy to understand.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to keep visual hierarchy focused on the product.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when product clarity is not sacrificed for style.

behaviors.name: Marketplace localization
behaviors.description: Adapts messaging for regional buying habits, formats, and cultural expectations.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests localization notes without using private customer data.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when localized wording feels natural and respectful.

behaviors.name: Comparison-driven choice
behaviors.description: Prefers side-by-side options to choose the best image direction, headline, and offer framing.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks for comparison tables with pros and cons.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when tradeoffs are easy to compare.

behaviors.name: Mobile storefront check
behaviors.description: Reviews output for short copy, clear contrast, and fast comprehension on small screens.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests mobile-first copy and layout guidance.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it works at small display sizes.

personas.name: Grace Williams
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids unreleased announcements, executive schedules, financials, and confidential strategy
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers executive summaries and polished final copy

behaviors.name: Reputation protection
behaviors.description: Reviews creative choices for executive tone, public perception, and stakeholder sensitivity.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to identify reputational risks and offer refined alternatives.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it sounds polished and avoids controversy.

behaviors.name: Minimal-input delegation
behaviors.description: Provides concise direction and expects ChatGPT to produce a complete, polished draft.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Uses brief prompts and asks for executive-ready output.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it needs little rewriting.

behaviors.name: Stakeholder lens
behaviors.description: Considers how employees, customers, partners, and press might interpret the creative message.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Requests tone checks for multiple stakeholder groups.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when stakeholder reactions are considered.

behaviors.name: Executive brevity
behaviors.description: Prefers short, high-impact language over detailed explanations.
behaviors.chatgpt_interaction: Asks ChatGPT to shorten copy without losing authority.
behaviors.acceptance_signal: Accepts output when it is concise, confident, and clear.
